messages:
maya: quick note — I'm stuck at the airport, flight delayed. need someone to take primary for the 20:00-02:00 UTC window. i'll hand off runbook + pager. not expecting a long outage but want coverage.

oliver: i can take primary for that window, maya. what room/context should i be looking at? any active pages?

maya: thanks @oliver. two things: 1) there's a fresh pager from incident-bot about increased 5xxs on hosted inference; 2) runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-inference-5xx (check sections "Immediate mitigations" and "Scale/rollback"). i'll paste current notes below.

incident-bot: PAGER — 5xx surge on /v1/generate (hosted-api-prod) — 12.3% errors over last 5m, spike started ~00:35 UTC. Pager severity: P2. Affected customers: intermittent failures for small percentage of requests.

sam: tagging in. i'm currently secondary but can shadow until oliver fully takes over. main telemetry shows errors correlate with long seq lengths and tokenization failures in model xlarge-8q.

nina: FYI from infra — autoscaler already spun 2 extra pods in the EU region but latency for cold starts is causing retries that look like 5xx. we've throttled new model loads to prevent more retries.

oliver: got it. @sam i'll take the lead on triage. maya — any sticky state i should know?

maya: nothing sticky besides the usual KV cache warmup. check the runbook step 2 for prefix cache flush cmd. also note customer impact: a couple of high-throughput partners see 5–10% request failures. watch the customer-impact dashboard (link in runbook).

beau: quick checklist for immediate mitigation: 1) enable fallback-model-route to small-8q for requests > 1024 tokens, 2) reduce max_concurrency on new model loads to avoid overload, 3) add temporary 429 ramp for noisy clients. i've posted the commands below.

beau: ```
# enable fallback route (console cli)
redwood route update --name generate --fallback small-8q --if-errors 5

# reduce concurrency on model loads
redwood config set serving.max_load_concurrency=4 --model xlarge-8q

# temporary client rate limit
redwood quotas update --client noisy-partner --qps 10
```

sam: executing fallback route now. rolling change — doing canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. ping when canary looks stable.

deploy-bot: deploy started by sam: route update generate fallback -> small-8q (canary 5%). CI checks passed.

oliver: watching telemetry: errors drop to 6.8% after canary, p50 latency stable, p95 improved slightly. moving to 25% canary.

maya: thanks team. i'm leaving a short runbook note: "flight delay; swapped primary to oliver, sam shadowing; enabled small-8q fallback; watching p95 and 5xx; infra limited concurrent loads."

sam: can we also open a short-term incident ticket for postmortem? capture root-cause suspects (model load cold start + long sequences + retry storm). i'll draft.

oliver: confirmed taking primary for 20:00-02:00 UTC window. sam you are secondary. maya will be reachable but offline-ish. nina, can infra keep autoscale thresholds conservative for next 90m?

nina: yes — holding new model loads and keeping one extra warm instance. i'll post exact thresholds in the ticket.

ops-prod: noted customer-impact: two partners reported 7% failure rate; CS notified with templated message. link to CS ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-7123.

sam: can oliver ack that you have pager on and phone reachable? we should also enable `pagerduty:notify-secondary` in case primary doesn't ack.

oliver: ack — pager on, phone on do-not-disturb except for pages. will ack within 2 minutes. also adding a quick watchlist: metrics/kpis -> hosted-api-prod -> 5xx_rate, p95_latency, active_model_loads.

maya: ty both. leaving a short handoff summary in team calendar. please escalate to L2 if errors go back >10% after mitigations. escalation path is in runbook (section 4).

beau: reminder: if fallback causes quality regression, we can do traffic-split 80/20 and enable QA flag `suppress-fallback` for whitelisted customers. dont forget to note any customer-visible regressions in the postmortem.

oliver: will do. current plan: watch for 30m after full canary then rollback fallback if stable and open postmortem. for now primary handoff confirmed. thanks @maya, have a safe flight. :plane:

maya: thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. :thumbsup:
